```yaml
name: Termux Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * 0'  # Weekly on Sunday at midnight

jobs:
  termux-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      
      - name: Set up QEMU
        uses: docker/setup-qemu-action@v3
        
      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3
        
      - name: Build Termux container
        run: |
          docker build -t btcrecover-termux -f .github/dockerfiles/Dockerfile.termux .
          
      - name: Run tests in Termux container
        run: |
          docker run --rm btcrecover-termux python run-all-tests.py -vv --no-pause --no-buffer
          
  termux-test-full-requirements:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: termux-test
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      
      - name: Set up QEMU
        uses: docker/setup-qemu-action@v3
        
      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3
        
      - name: Build Termux container with full requirements
        run: |
          docker build -t btcrecover-termux-full -f .github/dockerfiles/Dockerfile.termux.full .
          
      - name: Run tests with full requirements in Termux container
        run: |
          docker run --rm btcrecover-termux-full python run-all-tests.py -vv --no-pause --no-buffer

# Documentation:
# Both base and full requirements are tested in CI:
# - Base requirements are tested in the first job (termux-test)
# - Full requirements are tested in the second job (termux-test-full-requirements)
# The full requirements include additional dependencies from requirements-full.txt
```
